rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt / FROM "AL_D198_26410_20250115" / WHERE ("A4" LIKE '% 청룡동' OR "A4" = '청룡동') AND "A4" LIKE '%금정구%' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("A29"::text, '')) = '문교사회용' OR TRIM(COALESCE("A29"::text, '')) = '공공용');

rows.q: 동래구 명장동 다가구주택 평균 건물건축면적과 건수
rows.sql: SELECT AVG(b."A18"::float8) AS "avg_building_area_m2", /        COUNT(*) AS "n" / FROM "AL_D198_26260_20250115" b / WHERE b."A3" LIKE '26260%' AND (b."A25" = '단독주택' AND b."A27" = '다가구주택' AND b."A4" ILIKE '%명장동%');

rows.q: 금정구 서동 주거용 중 지하층 있는 채수
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt / FROM "AL_D198_26410_20250115" / WHERE ("A4" LIKE '% 서동' OR "A4" = '서동') AND "A4" LIKE '%금정구%' AND TRIM(COALESCE("A29"::text, '')) = '주거용';
